notes.title: Scifi Theme Teaser!
notes.content:
[h1]SCIFI THEME TEASER[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35588155/342f6a74dc4386c1b63bfda86159fed812698aba.gif[/img]

We're getting closer to releasing our first demo which will showcase the Scifi Theme of Escape Room Simulator... here are a few teaser gifs which will give you an idea of some of the cool things the Scifi theme aims to bring.

Lasers make cool additions to any room...
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35588155/d4224d32f1a77223e2655a83333cd56299227de9.gif[/img]

Sometimes all you need is a little power!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35588155/0ae3ed0c63131b2ce3771dd17c06056773732af6.gif[/img]

Nothing like keeping someone in suspense...
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35588155/27aa3ad4261500fe5e877449455278cde312207f.gif[/img]
